text: And tried to put his foot upon Peter, who jumped out of a window, upsetting three plants. The window was too small for Mr. McGregor, and he was tired of running after Peter. He went back to his work. Peter sat down to rest; he was out of breath and trembling with fright, and he had not the least idea which way to go. Also he was very damp with sitting in that can. After a time he began to wander about, going lippity--lippity--not very fast, and looking all round.
title: Peter Jumps Out and Wanders Lost
director_note: Peter lands in a tumble of overturned pots and rests damp and trembling before a slow, wary lippity-lippity exit; McGregor's failed reach and tired retreat clear the stage so the quiet can breathe. The wander ends with Peter looking all round, lost and small against the walled garden.
